messages:
Lina: Hot take: vanilla is the unsung hero of ice cream. Change my mind. :ice_cream:
Jordan: blasphemy. chocolate forever. :chocolate_bar:
Priya: both are good, but vanilla is the canvas. add toppings = win. :paintbrush:
Marcus: I will fight you for a double chocolate sundae. :boxing_glove: (also brought mini tubs to the kitchen)
Sam: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/ice-cream-celebrate-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA -> mood
Lina: Marcus? mini tubs? where are you hiding them :eyes:
Marcus: Kitchen, top shelf behind the fancy mug that no one claims. Help yourselves. :sunglasses:
Priya: Marcus, you're a hero. +1 kudos :trophy:
DevBot: Reminder: Please label any communal food with your name and date. Unlabeled items will be assumed to be fair game after 48 hours.
Jordan: also, quick poll: chocolate vs vanilla vs other?
PollBot: Poll created by Jordan: "Chocolate or Vanilla (or Other)" — react with :chocolate_bar:, :ice_cream: (vanilla), or :question: (other). Poll ends in 2 hours.
Sam: other -> cookie dough all the way. :cookie:
Lina: added :ice_cream: for vanilla. low-key proud.
Priya: added :chocolate_bar: bc compromise is hard.
Marcus: added both because impartiality. :man_shrugging:
Jordan: results so far: chocolate 2, vanilla 2, other 1. good tension. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Lina: Whoever wins owes the rest of us a toppings bar next Friday. stakes.
Marcus: deal. I'll bring sprinkles and hot fudge. :sparkles:
Sam: noted. I'm assigning myself to napkin duty. :memo:
Lina: meeting adjourned. good banter, good ice cream. :raised_hands:
